*Saraṇaduka, Hetusampayuttaduka* is an Abhidhamma text forming a component section of the *Paṭṭhāna* within the Pali Tipiṭaka. Within the analytical framework of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text systematically investigates conditional relations (*paccaya*) by cross-combining categories of dyads (*duka*), here pairing the *saraṇaduka* (the dyad concerning states accompanied by corruptions or defilements) with the *hetusampayuttaduka* (the dyad concerning states associated with root causes).
